tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rjes chog gtang rag mchod bston ni/ 1$0000300hūm̐: dur khrod zhing mchog 'og min gnas su gsal: mchod rdzas sman rag gtor ma ye shes lnga: 'dod yon drug ldan tshogs kyis 'jig rten khengs: thabs shes gnyis med bde chen 'du 'bral med: phyi nang gsang gsum snod bcud bde ba che: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐

nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: sarba pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes byin brlabs nas/ oṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍa la shrī badz+ra yo gi nī oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ nas/ dhū pe puṣ+pe ā lo ke nai wid+yā shab+da 'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: snang stong dbyer med chos rnams kun gyi gzhi: mi skye mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid: gang la cis 'dul de la der ston pa'i: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces mchod bstod bya'o// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ/ shre yāṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ḍā ki nī mā me muñtsa/ ḍā ki nī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa 'chags so/// /
